ZOTAC GAMING GeForce RTX 4070 Ti AMP AIRO SPIDER-MAN™: Across the Spider-Verse Bundle

ZT-D40710F-10SMP

Love Gaming with the all-new ZOTAC GAMING GeForce® graphics card powered by the NVIDIA Ada Lovelace architecture and DLSS 3. The ZOTAC GAMING GeForce RTX 4070 Ti AMP AIRO integrates next generation technologies, breakthrough bandwidth, and ultra-fast graphics memory to power the win. Using cutting-edge cooling technologies derived from the flagship model and designed with aerodynamic concepts for an AIROptimized flow, AMP AIRO features a premium design, is refined with noise enhancements, strong durability, and enables stronger performance.

This Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse inspired bundle includes a number of themed goodies, such as a magnetic backplate and custom fan emblems to make the AMP AIRO extra stylish, as well as a figurine, a tote bag and more that fans are sure to love.
